periods.time: Flashback to the first week of Hestia Familia

name.zh: 贝尔初次打倒哥布林与赫斯缇雅眷族初期生活
name.en: Bell's First Goblin and Hestia Familia's Early Days

periods.location: Hestia Familia hidden church room; Orario streets; Guild headquarters
periods.summary: Soon after joining Hestia Familia, Bell proudly reports defeating a Goblin, only to become embarrassed when Hestia points out it was only one monster. The flashback shows their poor but warm early life: Bell's first dungeon earnings, Hestia's potato-pop job, her failed attempt to buy him an impossibly expensive weapon, and Miach teaching her that new familias must register with the Guild.
periods.cause: The side story recalls how Bell and Hestia began building their familia bond before the main events of the series.
periods.process: Bell registers as an adventurer and nervously begins dungeon work. Hestia tries to contribute through part-time work and recruitment, notices Bell admiring an 8,000,000-valis Hephaestus knife, then realizes her own hair ribbons are fraying. Later, Miach visits with a potion sample and guides Hestia through familia registration and rank basics at the Guild.
periods.outcome: Hestia recognizes Bell's earnestness and growing independence while also feeling the poverty and insecurity of a new goddess with one child.
periods.aftermath: This setup leads into Hestia's jealousy when she sees Bell showing a gift box to Eina at the Guild.
periods.significance: Establishes the emotional baseline of Bell and Hestia's relationship: poverty, mutual reliance, Bell's innocence, and Hestia's growing attachment to her first child.
